With President Marcos postponing the fare hike, they are instead calling for a rollback in fuel prices, particularly on existing fuel supplies.

Some drivers continue to ply the streets, hoping to bring home income for their families as the oil crisis persists due to the conflict in the Middle East.

📷 Tara Yap | MB

PISTON: FUEL EXCISE TAX AT VAT DAPAT ANG SINUSPINDE, HINDI FARE HIKE

WATCH: Mody Floranda, national president of transport group PISTON, calls for the suspension of the value-added and excise taxes amid the rising fuel prices.

Floranda says the fuel subsidy and cash aid from the government would help but not enough to cushion the impact of the hefty pump price increases. 

He says around 10,000 jeepney drivers are expected to participate in the transport strike in Metro Manila, part of the 50,000-100,000 nationwide.

KAPIHAN SA WELGA: Nagsimula na ang transport strike sa Cubao, Quezon City ngayong March 19, 2026, upang ipanawagan ang agarang pagpapababa sa mataas na presyo ng produktong petrolyo sa Pilipinas. 

Binuksan ang welga sa pamamagitan ng protesta, na sinundan ng almusal ng kape at pandesal. Kalahok dito ang jeepney drivers at operators, kasama ang kabataan, church workers, at BPO workers. Kasabay ng protesta, inilunsad sa welga ang mga diskusyon tungkol sa mga dahilan ng pagsirit ng presyo ng langis. Kabilang dito ang umiiral na Oil Deregulation Law, VAT, at Excise Tax, at ang panggegera ng US at Israel sa West Asia.

Inilunsad ang welga kontra oil price hike sa buong bansa ngayong araw. | Neil Eco/Altermidya
